fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend. Passing it along isn't what the verse says. The LORD of Hosts says, “You most certainly must drink it!” (Jeremiah 25:28). Handing it off like a hot tray out of the oven isn't in that line. The word to a nation that refuses is that they must drink.

problems.problem: “No passing, friend” still implies that the cup cannot be passed along, which the passage does not say.
